svg.title: Finite central partition extraction: repair all cells and select one for every target
svg.desc: A schematic of Theorem 85.7, not a numerical core realization. An actual finite projection is cut by represented smaller-center projections. The exact pinching identity measures its added commutator cost. A common matrix deletion multiplies traces by n squared. Feasible trimming gives integer dimensions on each positive cell. The total trace-weighted bound chooses one cell for all ambient unitary targets. The simultaneous small pinching estimate remains an input.
svg.text: Repair every central cell, then select one cell for all targets
Actual core S in R; A = <N,e> in B = <M,e>. Physical center Z(S) and its represented lift are distinct.
1. Finite projection and a scalar step from below
zeta = C_A(p), c = Tr(p) > 0; h = sum_i theta_i z_i <= zeta
t = tau(h) > 0; rho = (c - t)/t
Finite central partition z_0 + z_1 + ... + z_r = 1; p_i = p z-hat_i. (85.18)
z_r
Zero cell includes discarded tails.
2. Exact pinching identity, before selecting a cell
The off-diagonal blocks are orthogonal in L2. This is (85.17), for each j.
Lambda = sum_j sum_(i != l) ||p_i u_j p_l||_2^2; mu = 2 Lambda/c
Sum all targets first: sum_(i,j) ||[p_i,u_j]||_2^2 = c (delta^2 + mu). (85.19)
3. Actual common M_n deletion and feasible integer trimming
Old traces and squared L2 norms multiply by n^2. Centers are preserved. (52.3)
k_i = floor(n^2 theta_i) >= k_0; q_i <= p_i; C_(A-tilde)(q_i) = k_i z_i; q_0 = 0
T_n = sum_(i >= 1) k_i tau(z_i); s = tau(sum_(i >= 1) z_i); b = s/(n^2 t) < 1
Total trim cost = n^2 c - T_n <= n^2 rho t + s
T_n >= (1 - b)n^2 t > 0. Prescription and cost: (85.20), (85.22).
4. One nonzero q_i works for every u_1, ..., u_m
max_j ||[q_i,u_j]||_(2,new) / sqrt(Tr_new(q_i)) <= Gamma
Gamma = sqrt((1 + rho)/(1 - b)) sqrt(delta^2 + mu)
+ 2 sqrt(m(rho + b)/(1 - b)). Trace-weighted selection: (85.21), (85.23).
q_i splits into k_i pieces equivalent to the new Jones corner e_new z-hat_i. (52.4)
Automatic: finite scalar approximation, (85.25)-(85.26). Missing: simultaneous small actual Lambda and profile loss.
